gaps.summary: Consolidate docs and native work, close obsolete PR, preserve evidence branches, then normalize main.
Replace conflicting two-arm/synthetic designs with a frozen three-arm real-client experiment.
Materialize the verified Rust source as normal checked-in files and run CI directly from checkout.
Add sessions, turns, messages, native mappings, memory lifecycle, handoffs, runs, approvals, artifacts, materializations, cursors, audit, and tombstones.
Implement exact CLI runbook, JSON/dry-run behavior, per-user service lifecycle, typed IPC, backup/restore/uninstall.
Implement and live-test Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, and OpenCode adapters with safe-mode version probing.
Implement canonical memory lifecycle, session/history projection, native resume/fork, and signed cross-platform handoffs with code state.
Implement durable run/command/approval/subagent orchestration, recovery, budgets, worktree isolation, and capability attenuation.
Complete Oxc extraction, Tree-sitter packs/injections, LibCST, mvdan shell semantics, real LSP matrix, Turbo CLI/probes, and Next DevTools merge.
Implement cross-host rule/skill/agent compiler, compatibility report, diff/backup/rollback, echo prevention, and load verification.
Add provider/plugin interfaces, stable SDKs, CI mode, editor integration, and webhook/SIEM export.
Add optional licensed/checksummed hybrid lexical/vector/graph search with sensitivity exclusions.
Build full Tauri desktop, Expo mobile, typed remote API, pairing, relay, push, approvals, and first-class UX.
Complete keychain/encryption, policy/capabilities, path/shell/prompt defenses, fuzzing, performance, accessibility, privacy, OS and release assurance.
Produce signed/notarized/store distributions and staged GA only after all evidence gates.
